def _no_overrides_codegen_creation_executor(
        caller_creations=None,
        owner_creations=None,
        caller_creations_lock_held=False,
        steps=steps,
        step_spells=step_spells,
        step_spell_ids=step_spell_ids,
        step_has_disposal_methods=step_has_disposal_methods,
        step_disposal_methods=step_disposal_methods,
        step_existences=step_existences,
        step_instance_keys=step_instance_keys,
        step_dep_keys=step_dep_keys,
        root_instance_key=root_instance_key,
        SpellGeneralizedCodegenPlanTargetKind=SpellGeneralizedCodegenPlanTargetKind,
        _construct_spell_instance=_construct_spell_instance,
        _raise_meld_construction_error=_raise_meld_construction_error,
        _get_existing_creation=_get_existing_creation,
        _register_spell_instance_prebound=_register_spell_instance_prebound,
        MeldExecutionError=MeldExecutionError,
        SpellSpaceScopeError=SpellSpaceScopeError,
    ):
    instance_results = {}
    plan_step_0 = steps[0]
    spell_0 = step_spells[0]
    spell_id_0 = step_spell_ids[0]
    has_disposal_methods_0 = step_has_disposal_methods[0]
    disposal_methods_0 = step_disposal_methods[0]
    existence_0 = step_existences[0]
    owner_creations_0 = spell_0._owner_creations
    if owner_creations_0 is not None:
        creations_0 = owner_creations_0
    elif owner_creations is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "No-overrides codegen OWNER execution requires owner_creations."
        )
    else:
        creations_0 = owner_creations
    use_spell_lock_0 = True
    if (
            caller_creations_lock_held
            and creations_0 is caller_creations
    ):
        use_spell_lock_0 = False
    instance_0 = _get_existing_creation(spell=spell_0, creations=creations_0, existence=existence_0)
    if instance_0 is None:
        if use_spell_lock_0:
            with spell_0._lock:
                with creations_0._lock:
                    instance_0 = _get_existing_creation(spell=spell_0, creations=creations_0, existence=existence_0)
                if instance_0 is None:
                    try:
                        instance_0 = spell_0.spell()
                    except Exception as exc:
                        _raise_meld_construction_error(spell_0, exc)
                    with creations_0._lock:
                        creations_0.add_creation(
                            spell_id_0,
                            instance_0,
                            has_disposal_methods=has_disposal_methods_0,
                            disposal_methods=disposal_methods_0,
                        )
        else:
            with creations_0._lock:
                instance_0 = _get_existing_creation(spell=spell_0, creations=creations_0, existence=existence_0)
                if instance_0 is None:
                    try:
                        instance_0 = spell_0.spell()
                    except Exception as exc:
                        _raise_meld_construction_error(spell_0, exc)
                    creations_0.add_creation(
                        spell_id_0,
                        instance_0,
                        has_disposal_methods=has_disposal_methods_0,
                        disposal_methods=disposal_methods_0,
                    )
    instance_results[step_instance_keys[0]] = instance_0
    if root_instance_key not in instance_results:
        raise MeldExecutionError(
            spell_id=root_instance_key[0],
            spell_name=root_instance_key[0],
            message=f"No-overrides codegen root instance '{root_instance_key[0]}' is missing.",
        )
    return instance_results[root_instance_key]
